user.title: Choose the connector location
user.description: Run the reverse Modbus/TLS listener inside Home Assistant, or connect to a separately hosted connector.

data_description.mode: embedded runs the EMMA TLS listener in Home Assistant; external connects to the standalone Python server.

embedded.title: Run the EMMA TLS server in Home Assistant
embedded.description: Choose the TLS port EMMA will connect to. Automatic mode creates a private local CA and server certificate under /config/huawei_emma_management. For custom mode, enter paths relative to /config or absolute paths such as /ssl/fullchain.pem.

data.certificate_name: Certificate DNS name or IP address

data_description.certificate_name: Use the exact fixed IP address or DNS name configured as the management server in EMMA.
data_description.certificate_path: Required only when Certificate source is custom.
data_description.private_key_path: Required only when Certificate source is custom.
data_description.private_key_password: Leave empty for an unencrypted key.

external.title: Connect to an external EMMA connector
external.description: A new random API key is suggested. Put exactly this value in the external server's .env as EMMA_API_TOKEN, restart that server, then submit this form.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach a connected EMMA through the connector. Check its address, API key, service, and firewall.
error.invalid_auth: The external connector rejected the API key.
error.certificate_paths_required: Custom certificate mode requires both certificate and private-key paths.
error.invalid_certificate: The custom certificate or private key is missing, invalid, expired, or does not match.

abort.already_configured: This EMMA connector is already configured.

error.certificate_paths_required: Custom certificate mode requires both certificate and private-key paths.
error.invalid_certificate: The custom certificate or private key is missing, invalid, expired, does not match, or does not cover the configured name.

init.title: Huawei EMMA connector settings
init.description: Changes restart this integration entry. Embedded mode can change its listener port and certificate name; external mode can update its server address and API key.
